Date November 9, 1939.

Subject. Denis Neuberg, Clerical Assistant of the P.W.D., reported to be
broadcasting Transocean news over Station XHB.
Made by D.S.I. MacAdie Forwarded by C. Crawford. S.B.

It is reported that Denis Neuberg, a Clerical
Assistant of the S.M.C. P.W.D., is engaged in broadcasting
Transocean News reports over Station XHB, Lane 504,
House No. 36, Avenue Foch.

Karl August Neuberg, German Eurasian and father of
Denis Neuberg, regularly acted as commentator for
Transocean News which is pro-German and anti-Allied
in nature from the inception of the broadcast until
November 2nd when a younger but similar voice was heard.
Since that date both Karl Neuberg's and the new voice
which is reported to be that of his son, have been heard
irregularly.

Whether the elder Neuberg, who is employed in a
British firm, the Confederation Life Association, 51
Canton Road, has had pressure brought to bear on him
to discontinue this propaganda work or whether he intends
to hand the work over to his son for other reasons, is
not known.

R. W. Mac Adie
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

Commr. of Police.

主题。据报，工务处（P.W.D.）文书助理 Denis Neuberg 在 XHB 电台播报跨洋新闻。
由副督察长 MacAdie 制作，经特务科 C. Crawford 转发。

据报，上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.）工务处（P.W.D.）的文书助理 Denis Neuberg，正在福煦路（Avenue Foch）504弄36号的 XHB 电台播报跨洋新闻（Transocean News）报道。

Karl August Neuberg，德裔欧亚混血儿，系 Denis Neuberg 之父，自该广播开播起至11月2日止，定期担任具有亲德和反同盟国性质的跨洋新闻评论员；11月2日那天，听到一个较年轻但相似的声音。自该日起，Karl Neuberg 的声音以及据报为其子的新声音，均不定期出现。

年长的 Neuberg 受雇于一家英国公司——广东路51号的联合人寿协会（Confederation Life Association），不知是否因受到压力而停止此项宣传工作，亦或是出于其他原因打算将工作移交给其子，目前尚不清楚。

R. W. Mac Adie
副督察长

3rd BRANCH REGISTRY

Date 31 / 5 / 40）

by dia Yorke.

I should be very grateful if you could
have confidential enquiries made as to the possible
anti-British activities of Mr. K.A. NEUBORG.
NEUBORG is one of the Agency Staff of the
Confederated Life Association, he is a German or
part-German Eurasian with a German passport, but
speaks little or no German, so I am told.

I understand he was one of 4 or 5 who
used to broadcast the German Trans-Ocean news at
the beginning of the war, but I am informed, how
correctly I don't know, that he no longer does this
and that he gave it up last October or so.

He has a brother here and it is possible
that the anti-British activities of one may be
credited (or debited) to the other.

Please forgive me for troubling you in
this matter.

yours sincerely,
R Hayes.

R. W. Yorke, Esq.,
Headquarters, Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

by dia Yorke.

如蒙对 K.A. NEUBORG 先生可能存在的反英活动进行秘密调查，我将不胜感激。
NEUBORG 是联合人寿协会（Confederated Life Association）代理机构的一名职员，他是德国人或部分德裔的欧亚混血儿，持有德国护照，但据我所知，他几乎不会说德语或完全不会说德语。

我获悉，战争初期，他是播报德国跨洋新闻的四五人之一，但据告知（我不确定此消息是否准确），他已不再从事此项工作，并于去年十月左右放弃。

他有一个兄弟在此地，因此其中一人的反英活动可能会被归功（或归咎）于另一人。

请原谅我在此事上打扰您。

此致，
R Hayes.

R. W. Yorke 先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处总部，
上海。

REPORT
Date Oct 20 1939.
Subject Karl August NEUBOURG - German Eurasian commentator of
Transocean News reports over Radio Station XNHB.
Made by D.S. Pitts Forwarded by C. Crawford. J. L
In regard to the daily broadcasting in the
English language over Radio Station XNHB located at
House 36, 504 Avenue Foch, of pro-German and anti-
allied propaganda sponsored by the German Transocean
News Agency, I have to report that the announcer is
one Karl August NEUBOURG, a German Eurasian, born
in Shanghai on August 14, 1892.
NEUBOURG, who cannot speak German, was
educated at St. Francis Xavier's School in Shanghai,
but he was not regarded as being an intelligent
student.
Little is known of his activities between
the time he left school in about 1909 till the
conclusion of the Great War.
In 1919 he was appointed manager of the
Klauber Trading Corporation, 10 Kiukiang Road, an
import and export concern, but the business failed
before long and for some time he was unemployed.
In 1921, NEUBOURG became assistant manager
of the China Garage Company, under the directorship
of his brother. He stayed in this position for
two years and then entered the insurance business.
From 1923 until 1929 he was with the
Manufacturers Life Insurance Company of Canada,
from 1929 till 1934 with the Sun Life of Canada,
the next two years, with Associated Life Underwriters
Commr. of Police
Sir:
Information
Jno Robertson
D. C. (Sp. Br.)

To E. Sant 2/10. C.
E
S : C. G

主题：卡尔·奥古斯特·诺伊堡（Karl August NEUBOURG）——德裔欧亚混血评论员，在XNHB广播电台播报跨洋新闻社（Transocean News）的报道。
制作人：D.S. Pitts 转呈人：C. Crawford. J. L
关于位于福煦路504号36室的XNHB广播电台每日播出的英语节目，该节目传播由德国跨洋新闻社赞助的亲德及反盟国宣传内容，兹报告称，播音员系卡尔·奥古斯特·诺伊堡（Karl August NEUBOURG），一名德裔欧亚混血儿，1892年8月14日出生于上海。
诺伊堡不会讲德语，曾在上海的圣方济各沙勿略学校（St. Francis Xavier's School）接受教育，但他并不被视为聪明的学生。
对于他在1909年左右离校至第一次世界大战结束期间的活动，知之甚少。
1919年，他被任命为九江路10号克劳伯贸易公司（Klauber Trading Corporation）的经理，这是一家进出口商行，但不久后生意失败，他失业了一段时间。
1921年，诺伊堡在其兄长的领导下，成为中国汽车行（China Garage Company）的副经理。他在此职位上待了两年，随后进入保险业。
从1923年至1929年，他就职于加拿大制造商人寿保险公司（Manufacturers Life Insurance Company of Canada）；1929年至1934年，就职于加拿大太阳人寿保险公司（Sun Life of Canada）；接下来的两年，就职于联合人寿承保人公司（Associated Life Underwriters）。

and since then with the Confederation Life Association,
51 Canton Road where he is still employed.

During the entire period he has been
connected with insurance concerns, he has spent his
time in selling life insurance policies on a
commission basis and his efforts have been quite
successful, he having been able to maintain a good
standard of livelihood. He is at present residing
at 432 Hamilton House with his wife.

Prior to the declaration of war on September
3, 1939, NEUBOURG was not a member of the local Nazi
party and being a Eurasian was not well received by
the local German community. He has never, until
recently, forcibly expressed himself as being a believer
in or follower of Nazism and has invariably been
regarded as a rather reticent type of person not
interested in politics.

Lately, however, he has been heard to
voice rather mild pro-German beliefs but in his office
it is not known that it is he who broadcasts the daily
outbursts in which he violently attacks the news
items of local British journals and news agencies vis-
a-vis the war situation in Europe.

NEUBOURG has a daughter and three sons, one
of whom, Denis, is a clerical assistant employed in the
Public Works Department of the Shanghai Municipal
Council.

此后至今，他就职于联邦人寿协会（Confederation Life Association），地址为广东路51号，目前仍受雇于此。

在他从事保险行业的整个期间，他以佣金制方式推销人寿保险单，其工作相当成功，得以维持良好的生活水平。他目前与妻子居住在汉密尔顿公寓（Hamilton House）432号。

在1939年9月3日宣战之前，诺伊堡并非当地纳粹党的成员，且作为欧亚混血儿，他在当地德国社区中并不受欢迎。直到最近，他从未强烈表达过自己是纳粹主义的信徒或追随者，且一直被视为一个相当沉默寡言、对政治不感兴趣的人。

然而，最近有人听到他发表较为温和的亲德言论，但在其办公室内，无人知晓正是他每日进行那些激烈的广播抨击，针对欧洲战事局势猛烈攻击本地英国报刊和新闻机构的新闻条目。

诺伊堡育有一女三子，其中一子丹尼斯（Denis）是上海公共租界工部局工务处的办事员。

- 3 -
K. A. NEUBOURG has never previously come to
the notice of the Police from a detrimental angle and
he is spoken of by his present employers, a British
concern, as being an honest, reliable and hardworking
man. His services, however, are likely to be
dispensed with at any time due to the incidence of
the Enemy Trading Act.
As far as can be ascertained, NEUBOURG, whose
fundamental outlook on life is more British than
German, has never previously indulged in pro-German
matters of any kind, but it is more than possible that
he is under some kind of obligation to the local
Germans and that Mr. S. LAHMANN, leader of the Nazis
here, on whose instructions the broadcasts in question
began, remunerates him well for his services. NEUBOURG
speaks well and with plenty of self-assurance over the
radio and mainly concerns himself with the ridiculing
of all news not emanating from German sources. But
in private life, he is a quiet man and on the surface,
totally apathetic to political events. True he is a
German, but his home and his upbringing have both been
in Shanghai where German influence has had not the
slightest part in the forming of his character.
Photograph of K.A. NEUBOURG attached herewith.
Jas. Dickes.
D. S.
D.C. (Special Branch)

K. A. 诺伊堡此前从未因不良行为引起警方注意，他目前的雇主（一家英国商行）称其为诚实、可靠且勤奋的人。然而，由于《敌国贸易法》的实施，他的服务随时可能被终止。
据查，诺伊堡的基本人生观更偏向英国式而非德国式，此前从未参与任何类型的亲德事务，但极有可能他对当地德国人负有某种义务，且这里的纳粹头目S. 拉曼（S. LAHMANN）先生（相关广播即按其指示开始）为其服务支付了丰厚的报酬。诺伊堡在广播中口齿伶俐，充满自信，主要致力于嘲讽所有非来自德国来源的新闻。但在私人生活中，他是一个安静的人，表面上对政治事件完全冷漠。诚然，他是德国人，但他的家庭和成长经历均在上海，德国影响在其性格形成中未起丝毫作用。
附K.A. 诺伊堡照片一张。
Jas. Dickes.
